name: Aritra Karmakar
portfolio_hero_text: Shipping Production-Grade Full Stack Systems, End-to-End
profile__summary: Welcome! I'm Aritra — a Senior Full Stack Developer at IISc who owns products end to end, from PostGIS schema to FastAPI/Flask service to React UI to Nginx config to CI/CD pipeline. I was the sole founding architect of a city-scale engineering programme, was promoted to Senior after delivering five platforms ahead of schedule, and now lead a 3-developer team. I drop below the web tier when the runtime demands it — migrating long-running Python to C++/Eigen for 95% faster runtime, and rearchitecting a 2.16-billion-row aggregation to run 6.7× faster with byte-identical output.

educations.ed__qualification: B.E in Information Science and Engineering

educations.ed__inst: BURDWAN SRI RAMAKRISHNA SARADAPITH UCHHA VIDYALAYA

contributions: Engineering Leadership: Lead a 3-developer team across a polyglot TypeScript, Python and C++ codebase — 100% code-review coverage on every pull request before merge, with SOLID boundaries, strict typing and test coverage set as the team standard.

Technical Hiring: Own the technical interview round for full-time developer hiring on my own team and for two further project teams; design scenario-based questions drawn from live project requirements, and ran one full-time position end to end from resume shortlist through technical assessment to hire.

Delivery Planning: Draft the requirements and run sprint-driven planning that kept five city-scale platforms landing on or ahead of schedule, breaking research goals into deliverables the team can estimate and commit to.

Architecture Governance: Authored the project's first Architecture Decision Record and a 5-stack × 19-dimension technology decision matrix (Tauri+React+FastAPI against C++/Qt, Java, PySide6 and .NET) to justify the desktop architecture before a line was written.

M3DM Desktop Product: Owned architecture and led the 3-developer delivery of a four-tier Windows desktop product replacing a QGIS-and-WSL toolchain — React + strict TypeScript + Tauri (Rust) shell over a 78-route FastAPI service and five native C++/CUDA engines, shipped as a code-signed offline installer needing no Python, Node, Rust or WSL on the target machine.

M3DM Performance: Rearchitected a matrix-aggregation stage from 104 DuckDB queries re-scanning 17.3 GB / 2.16 billion rows into a single-pass accumulation — 1,094s to 162.8s, 6.7× faster at parity 0.0 across all 416 datasets; diagnosed a GIL-contention stall starving the Uvicorn event loop and moved it to a dedicated subprocess for a further 2.75×.
Cross-Team Direction: Set technical direction for two further project teams and translate DULT and BOSCH stakeholder requirements into delivery scope, sequencing and architecture.

Enablement: Train engineers and researchers on Python multiprocessing, columnar Parquet and DuckDB SQL, replacing slow iterative Pandas scripts with sub-second out-of-core scans over multi-million-row datasets.

DST Production Platform: Designed and shipped the Digital Survey Tool (live at surveys.cistup.iisc.ac.in) — React + TypeScript frontend, Python Flask + psycopg3 backend, PostgreSQL with PostGIS geospatial schema — serving 10,000+ household surveys across 40+ field users for the Govt. of Karnataka 'City-Scale Travel Demand Model' project funded by Govt. of India and DULT.

API & Data Model: Designed 39 REST endpoints with 3-tier RBAC (Admin / Superuser / Enumerator); modeled the schema in PostgreSQL + PostGIS and sized the psycopg connection pool against 8 gunicorn workers (min=1 / max=4 per worker → 32 peak connections) for predictable capacity under load.

Frontend Complexity: Built a 6-page conditional form engine whose 16 routing branches govern field visibility and auto-populate sequential entries across a 3-level nested entity hierarchy, cutting redundant data entry ~70%; chose Context + useReducer over Redux to save ~14 KB gzipped; custom SearchableDropdown with 3-tier matching; 15-min cross-tab idle timeout via localStorage events polling every 30s rather than per keystroke.

Auth & Security: Designed a token-refresh mutex from a reactive 401 interceptor and singleton promise that ended concurrent refresh races logging users out mid-form; JWT (HS256, 15-min access + 7-day rotating refresh, bcrypt-hashed), mandatory TOTP 2FA via PyOTP for elevated roles, and server-side reCAPTCHA v3 verification.

VAPT & Hardening: Cleared the ISO VAPT security audit in two rounds (May 2026 — all 6 findings closed); remediated HTTP Request Smuggling (Nginx 1.14→1.26 on EOL CentOS 8.5), shipped 7 security headers with the always flag, HSTS preload-ready, CSP tuned for reCAPTCHA, rate limits (5/min on auth) and disabled production source maps.

Observability Platform: Built a solo, end-to-end 4-pillar observability stack (metrics, logs, traces, errors) as Docker Compose services on a private VPN — Prometheus + Grafana dashboards and alerting, OpenTelemetry into Tempo down to per-query spans, Loki centralised logs and self-hosted GlitchTip — solving multi-worker metric fragmentation via Prometheus multiprocess mode across 8 forked gunicorn workers, and replacing SSH-and-grep debugging with self-serve dashboards.

DevOps & CI/CD: Productionised with Docker Compose (nginx + flask + postgres on an isolated bridge network) and a GitHub Actions self-hosted runner on a private VPN — fixed SELinux blockers with chcon -t bin_t and NTP drift with chronyd makestep; zero-downtime deploys with health gating and automatic rollback; SAST (Bandit) + SCA (pip-audit) gated in CI.

Routing Data Pipeline: Made the build-vs-buy call and wrote a 10-worker threaded Python + Selenium pipeline extracting ~5M data points across 500K+ journey records over 4 time-of-day windows — the calibration and validation dataset the model could not otherwise be estimated against, at zero infra cost and ~₹5.7L of paid-API spend avoided.

ATDM & DTDM Plugins: Guided a 5-engineer team through the full SDLC on two desktop GIS modelling plugins as software SME — requirement specifications, architecture artifacts and test plans, lifting integration speed 30% by standardising environments; migrated long-running Python modules to C++ with Eigen for 95% faster runtime and 80% lower memory; built an out-of-core DuckDB pipeline over billion-row datasets, 90% faster; cut plugin crash rates 90%.

Analytics Dashboards: Developed a 29-page visualisation dashboard (Flask, Vanilla JS, Chart.js, Folium heatmaps) driven by strict JSON contracts, 80% faster to load after replacing in-tool aggregation with DuckDB; architected real-time admin dashboards with live progress, per-user throughput and status heatmaps with Excel export.

Field Operations: Trained a 40-member operations team and ran live triage across 8 months of ongoing production use; automated the post-collection analyst workflow in Python, removing 85% of manual effort and freeing roughly two analyst-weeks per cycle.

Vendor Codebase Ownership: Took ownership of a BOSCH-developed survey tool, ran a three-phase sanity-check analysis on pilot data and reported 13 tool-level defects plus 61 field-level issues; when the vendor declined to fix their own tool, resolved the defects directly — eliminating a submission race across an eight-step questionnaire, hardening GPS capture on low-end devices, fixing roster validation — and fed the decision to replace it with the in-house DST.
Resolved 3 product-dashboard issues (2 major + 1 minor) in the OSlash Snippets product using React + TypeScript; contributed fixes to the ProseMirror-based editor.
Built a responsive food-delivery web app (Zomato-style) on the MERN stack with the R&D Web Services team; integrated Paytm JS Checkout and user authentication.
Built a real-time video-calling web app with the R&D team: Django backend + WebSockets for audio/video/chat, Django auth for unique user IDs.
